playbooks.title: Self-serve instant refund on weekday dinner (Team C)
playbooks.action: Team C is overloaded on weekday dinner. Offer an in-app instant refund for missing item claims on orders up to ₹300 in that window, so these customers need no agent.
assumptions: ASSUMPTION: 60% of eligible customers use self-serve
policy choice: only orders up to ₹300

assumptions: ASSUMPTION: 30% of customers who see the banner do not open a ticket
